verdict.rationale: Bun keeps every downloaded package in a global cache at `~/.bun/install/cache` and hardlinks packages from there into projects. It also offers a cache-only mode that never touches the network and errors on a missing dependency, so cached installs are well documented. The evidence never addresses prebuilt binaries or avoiding source compilation of native modules. The only nearby fact is that Bun skips lifecycle scripts like `postinstall` by default, which is a security feature, not a prebuilt-binary mechanism. Missing for 10: documented support for prebuilt native/binary artifacts instead of source builds, any evidence on handling native addons, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cache-based install behavior.
